evidence_quotes.quid_pro_quo: Rep says 'This should take me about five to ten minutes' but does not frame the 10–15 minute window, promise of a dependable quote, or ask for explicit agreement before proceeding.
evidence_quotes.discovery_basics: Rep asks about moving only furniture and the partial move nature early on, but never explicitly asks for moving day or city-to-city route in a clear probing sequence. Name is provided by incoming caller ID / intro context only.
evidence_quotes.their_agenda: Never asked. Rep goes directly into inventory listing after the customer self-volunteers the furniture items.
evidence_quotes.two_layers_deep: N/A — no concerns raised by customer during this call.
evidence_quotes.active_listening_reflection: N/A — no concerns raised by customer during this call.
evidence_quotes.logistics_details_gathered: Rep covers property type (mobile home, multiple bedrooms), room/space descriptions, furniture items in detail, special considerations (washer/dryer, fridge disposition, flexibility on add-ons), truck fit confirmation. Comprehensive inventory capture.
evidence_quotes.packing_services_offered: Never asked. Customer volunteers they will handle boxes themselves, but rep does not offer paid packing services.
evidence_quotes.box_count_asked: Rep asks 'How about boxes? Do you think we're going to be moving any boxes?' Customer confirms they will handle all boxes.
evidence_quotes.estimate_anchor: Rep provides hourly rate ($103 for Fri/Sat, $97 for Mon–Thu per mover), trip fee ($75), minimum (2.5 hours), and prorates at 15-minute increments. Then gives range: '5 to 7 hours with an estimated cost of $1,180 to $1,592.' Personalizes to this inventory and notes truck fit.
evidence_quotes.pricing_framing: Rep discloses trip fee ($75) upfront, explains hourly structure, minimum, and 15-minute prorating. States 'we don't have anything like a fuel fee, no assembly/reassembly fees, no hidden fees at all.' Does not explicitly frame as 'not a guess' or use the 2.5-hour-minimum / 15-minute-increments commitment language as specified in the script.
evidence_quotes.feels_fair_then_silence: Never asked. Conversation transitions directly to 'Are you guys able to, like, email a quote' without any check-in on fairness or pricing comfort.
evidence_quotes.on_time_guarantee_delivered: Not mentioned. No reference to on-time guarantee or any discount terms.
evidence_quotes.damage_coverage_delivered: Not mentioned. No reference to No Worries Damage Coverage, $2,000 coverage, or any protection framing.
evidence_quotes.closes_the_loop: False. No summary, no 'Does that put those to rest?' The call moves directly to email quote and close without revisiting or confirming the Two Promises.
evidence_quotes.final_concerns_check: Not asked. Rep does not ask 'What's still concerning you about this move?' or any genuine concern-check variant. Call ends with customer saying 'Thank you' after agreeing to email quote.
evidence_quotes.catch_all_asked: Not asked. No version of 'Anything coming with you we haven't talked about?' posed.
evidence_quotes.explicit_ask: Never. Rep never asks 'Would you like our help with your move?' or any direct close. Instead, transitions to 'Once you're ready to get this scheduled, you can either give us a call back or respond to that email.' This is a soft out, not an explicit ask.
evidence_quotes.rate_lock_mentioned: Not mentioned. No rate-lock guarantee or deposit policy discussed.
evidence_quotes.booking_confirmed: None. No booking details confirmed. No date, phone number, arrival window, crew size, or addresses solidified on this call. Everything deferred to email and a later callback.

top_strength: Jules conducted a thorough, methodical inventory capture—walking the customer through every room and piece of furniture with patience and clarity, which produced a detailed, personalized estimate that accounts for specific items and truck capacity.
coaching_note: Section 2 (Their Concerns) and the closing sequence (Sections 5, 6, 7) were almost entirely skipped—Jules never asked what the customer's biggest concerns about the move were, never delivered the Two Promises, never asked a genuine final-concerns check, and never made an explicit ask for the business, leaving the sale hanging open and unconfirmed.
